input.quote: This Agreement shall renew automatically thereafter for successive one year periods until terminated pursuant to Section 12 herein or unless either Client or TrueLink deliver to the other written notice of intent not to renew no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year.
input.rationale:
Section 13 (p0078) provides an initial one-year term with automatic renewal for successive one-year (not multi-year) periods, and either party - including us as Client - may stop renewal on thirty (30) days' written notice. That window is inside the preferred 30-day standard and well inside the 60-day fallback, and the 12-month renewal term matches the preferred position; nothing approaches walk-away territory. Two preferred sub-elements are absent and are noted rather than redlined: no Vendor reminder 60 days before renewal, and no express renewal price cap (CPI/3%), though p0047 freezes Hosting Services costs for the first year and adds MFN rate protection in our favour. On its material terms the clause meets the preferred position, so we do not redline it.</rationale>
